description: This file contains unit tests for GatewayEnvironment functionalities, including parsing semantic versions, normalizing version output, checking version compatibility, and configuration defaults in the GatewayEnvironment component.

methods.name: `semver parses common forms`
methods.description: Unit test validating that various semantic version strings are correctly parsed or rejected.

methods.name: `gateway version output strips product prefix before parsing`
methods.description: Test verifying that the gateway version output string correctly strips the product prefix before parsing into a Semver object.

methods.name: `semver compatibility requires same major and not older`
methods.description: Test checking that semantic version compatibility logic enforces same major version and newer or equal minor and patch versions.

methods.name: `gateway port defaults and respects override`
methods.description: Test ensuring the default gateway port can be overridden via user defaults, with environment setup and cleanup.

methods.name: `expected gateway version from string uses parser`
methods.description: Test verifying that parsing a version string returns the correct Semver object or nil.
